name: b51-marina-night
js: const B=g.boats; if(!B.state().slip) B.buyBerth(true); for (const id of ['meridian72']) if(!B.owns(id)) B.order(id,true); B.deliver(true); while(B.slipBoat && B.slipBoat.id!=='meridian72') B.switchNext();

name: b51-yacht-night-berth
js: const B=g.boats; if(!B.state().slip) B.buyBerth(true); if(!B.owns('meridian72')) B.order('meridian72',true); B.deliver(true); while(B.slipBoat && B.slipBoat.id!=='meridian72') B.switchNext(); for(let i=0;i<4;i++) B.update(0.05,g.player); const b=B.slipBoat; window.__dbg={id:b&&b.id,x:b&&b.x,z:b&&b.z,yaw:b&&b.yaw,lights:b&&b.lights};

name: b51-police-night
js: const B=g.boats; B.forcePatrol=true; for(let i=0;i<3;i++) B.update(0.05,g.player); const b=B.police[0]; b.active=true; b.leaving=false; b.root.visible=true; b.mode='drive'; b.place(192,-1326,Math.PI/2,true); b.route=[{x:400,z:-1326}]; if(!b.crewChars) B.crewUp(b,0); for(let i=0;i<6;i++) B.update(0.05,g.player); window.__dbg={x:b.x,z:b.z,lights:JSON.stringify(b.lights)};

name: b51-police-day
js: const B=g.boats; B.forcePatrol=true; const b=B.police[0]; b.active=true; b.leaving=false; b.root.visible=true; b.mode='drive'; b.place(192,-1326,Math.PI/2,true); b.route=[{x:400,z:-1326}]; if(!b.crewChars) B.crewUp(b,0); for(let i=0;i<6;i++) B.update(0.05,g.player);

name: b51-sails-torn
js: const B=g.boats; const s=B.spawnNear('mirissa46',{x:120,z:-1320,yaw:0}); if(s){ s.mode='anchored'; s.berth={x:s.x,z:s.z,yaw:s.yaw}; s.setSailsVisible(true); for(let i=0;i<14;i++) s.sailHit(i%s.sails.length,{x:0.15+Math.random()*0.7,y:0.1+Math.random()*0.7}); s.place(120,-1320,-Math.PI/2.4,true); window.__dbg={id:s.id,holes:s.sails.map(q=>q.holes),tear:s.sails.map(q=>q.tear)}; }
